record.rationale: Browser-only complete ComplexColor Worker record preserves discriminator, raw double components, system-last color, independent theme/usage fields, ordered transformations and final color. A read-only layout view accesses only the actual maLastColor field missing from the native getter surface; decode reconstructs an actual native owner through existing setters without adding core persistence APIs.
